intro: Manage your personal details and the contact methods you use to sign in.
personalDescription: These details are used in your profile and company documents.
loginDescription: Add or change your email and phone number. New contact details must be verified with a code.
otpSent: We sent a verification code to {contact}.
codeResent: A new code has been sent.

errors.load: Refresh the page and try again.
errors.profileRequired: Enter your full name and company name. A saved BIN is also required to update the profile.
errors.save: Could not save your changes. Please try again.
errors.phoneFormat: Enter a Kazakhstan phone number in the format +7 777 000 00 00.
errors.contactSame: Enter a new contact method that differs from the current one.
errors.sendCode: Could not send the code. Check the contact and try again.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the six-digit code from the message.
errors.verifyCode: Could not verify the contact. Check the code and try again.
errors.resendCode: Could not resend the code. Please try again later.
